faqs.q: Who owns the property where the ditch is located?
faqs.a: A ditch company rarely owns the land on which it is located. More often, ditches go through property owned by others. The ditch company typically holds a prescriptive easement allowing the ditch company access to the property for the delivery of water and ditch maintenance without needing permission. Some ditch easements are recorded but a majority are prescriptive and are not included on development plats.
